title: Let candidates request a hint during an interview

round.title: What does a hint cost the candidate?
round.explanation: A hint helps, so it should probably cost something. This decides how the final score is worked out.

choices.label: Lowers the final score
choices.description: Each hint takes a set penalty off the total.

choices.label: Free, but capped
choices.description: No penalty, but only a few hints per interview.

choices.label: Costs time
choices.description: Each hint takes two minutes off the clock.

round.title: How much does a hint give away?
round.explanation: A first hint could be a gentle nudge or a full answer. This shapes the prompt the model gets.

choices.label: Escalates
choices.description: Nudge first, then the approach, then a walkthrough.

choices.label: Candidate picks
choices.description: The candidate chooses how deep the hint goes.

round.title: Where do hints come from?
round.explanation: Hints can be written ahead of time or generated when asked for.

choices.label: Generated on request
choices.description: The model writes the hint from the conversation so far.

choices.label: Written per question
choices.description: Authors add hints when they write a question.

choices.label: Written first, generated after
choices.description: Use the written hint, then generate more.
